history.summary: A 1,292 sqft 999-yr-leasehold 3BR (built 2002) at $2.0M / $1,548 PSF in D19, but a full 1.16km / 14-min walk from Kovan MRT and with no URA appreciation, transaction or median data. The quasi-freehold tenure is the lone clear positive against weak transit and an unverified value/liquidity picture.
history.rating_rationale: No URA series means appreciation and liquidity are unverified, and the low score (475) reflects the weak structural read. 1.16km to Kovan is a poor transit position for a $2.0M ticket — far outside the strong-uplift radius. A 24-year-old 3BR at $1,548 PSF is fairly priced for 999-yr tenure but offers no catalyst; this is a hold-for-the-land play, not a growth investment.
